title: Suresh K NDE 774
content:
On 17th December 1972, I had a most profound experience of my life, when I had a date, a close encounter, with death. Due to an abscess in my liver, I was hospitalized and had to undergo aspirations. The first one went off well but during the second aspiration, I felt something unusual happening. I felt that a number of spears were piercing my anus, and a great storm or whirlpool had started in my abdomen. Each center in my body was activated and energized. Life energy from every part, tissue, and cell of my body, was combining and trying to leave from the top of my head. My breathing had stopped, blood pressure was zero times zero, and still I could hear the doctors discussing what had happened. And then within a fraction of a second I traveled millions of miles and reached an area of the Light. The traveling was in the fourth dimension, which can be termed as an out of body experience, when an unidentified identity merged in 'that Light'. Words fail me as I try to describe exactly what I saw or felt. But I can say that there was no humanized God, all the same, it was an area of unalloyed purity. There was brilliant Light, immense speed or Motion and unbelievable Divine Love. I did not require senses to experience 'IT'. 'I' was absent and still I saw, knew and understood. Though I was there for a few seconds, it felt like an eternity. My concept of time and distance changed considerably, as I had traveled immeasurably long distance in a trillionth of a second and what seemed like an eternity was eternal sacredness condensed in our concept of time.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt 'a number of spears were piercing my anus' and 'a great storm or whirlpool had started in my abdomen'; 'life energy... was combining and trying to leave from the top of my head.'

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Described as traveling 'millions of miles' 'in the fourth dimension' within a fraction of a second, rather than a tunnel/void.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Traveled 'immeasurably long distance in a trillionth of a second.'

arrival.other_being_detail: An 'unidentified identity merged in that Light'; 'no humanized God.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as 'an area of the Light' and 'an area of unalloyed purity' with 'brilliant Light' and 'immense speed or Motion.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Hospitalized for a liver abscess; during the second aspiration 'my breathing had stopped, blood pressure was zero times zero.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Auditory awareness of doctors while breathing stopped ('still I could hear the doctors discussing what had happened'). Rapid travel described as 'fourth dimension.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Physiological crisis with continued hearing of doctors, then rapid travel and arrival in Light; no tunnel, beings, life review, or boundary described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Strong 'life energy' / chakra-like activation description ('Each center in my body was activated and energized... trying to leave from the top of my head'); 'I was absent and still I saw, knew and understood.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'My breathing had stopped, blood pressure was zero times zero, and still I could hear the doctors discussing what had happened.'; 'I traveled millions of miles and reached an area of the Light.'; 'There was no humanized God... an area of unalloyed purity.'; "'I' was absent and still I saw, knew and understood."
